bio.text: Wesley Bell represents Missouri's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House.
He grew up in North St. Louis County, attended Lindenwood University, and earned a law degree from the University of Missouri-Columbia School of Law.
Bell worked as a public defender, a municipal judge and prosecutor, and a criminology professor, and was elected to the Ferguson City Council in 2015.
In 2018 he was elected St. Louis County Prosecuting Attorney.
